_doc: Single committed source of measured truth for M3. Every value traces to a measurement (M1/M2) or is flagged as an assumption. See refine-logs/EVALUATION_CONTRACT_M3.md.

compression._doc: FP8_E5M2 KV deflate. M3 is dtype-gated: only FP8_E5M2 compresses profitably; BF16 / FP8_E4M3 provably cannot (entropy floor). LZ4 is a no-op (~1.0).
compression.alpha_provenance: M1: EXPERIMENT_LOG.md L38-42 (synthetic p50 0.715), L86-90 (real Qwen2.5-7B deflate-6 0.732; real gpt2 0.729-0.735). deflate-1 marginal ~0.75. Order-0 entropy floor 0.686.

decompress._doc: BF3 hardware deflate decompress, measured via doca_bench. EGRESS = decompressed-output rate. profitability.py's D term consumes COMPRESSED-INPUT bytes, so feed D = alpha * d_egress (D_input). See contract 'Units reconciliation'.
decompress.d_egress_provenance: M2: EXPERIMENT_LOG.md L178-183 (doca_bench, deflate decompress, queue depth 64). Egress Gbps column.
decompress.t_fixed_provenance: M2 R005: ~5 us/task fixed overhead; amortizes only at >=256 KB chunks.
decompress.min_chunk_provenance: M2 R005 design constraint: aggregate KV to >=256 KB before compressing; <256 KB does not amortize the fixed cost.
decompress.ceiling_caveat: The ~188 Gbps egress ceiling may be a PCIe-x8 artifact (host write-back saturated at ~87% of practical x8/dir), not the silicon. On x16 / DPU-local memory the profitable bandwidth ceiling could be ~2x higher (~376 Gbps). See EXPERIMENT_LOG.md L197+.

compress_band._doc: Sender-side compressor throughput C. Software is MEASURED and never pays at real link rates (motivates the asymmetric FPGA design). FPGA band is an ASSUMPTION to be measured in M4b.

software.provenance: M1: EXPERIMENT_LOG.md L65, L72. zlib.compress on real KV.

fpga.provenance: NetZIP MICRO 2025 (doi:10.1145/3725843.3756079) + FPGA deflate IP datasheets.
